{{Recipe}}

'''Nigerian Turmeric Rice''' is a vibrant and aromatic rice dish from Nigeria, colored yellow with turmeric and flavored with a blend of local spices. It is enjoyed across different regions and often served during festive occasions.
==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Chicken|Chicken]] (optional)
* 1½ de Rica can of long-grain [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]] powder
* 1 teaspoon Nigerian [[Cookbook:Curry Powder|curry powder]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]] powder
* 1 [[Cookbook:Red onion|red onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 small [[Cookbook:Bouillon Cube|stock cubes]]
* [[Cookbook:Chicken Stock|Chicken stock]]
* 3 pieces of fresh [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]

==Procedure==
# In a clean pot, combine chicken, stock cubes, half the onion, curry powder, and thyme. Cover with water, and cook until the chicken is tender.
# Parboil the rice for about 10 minutes. Drain the rice in a [[Cookbook:Sieve|sieve]], and immediately rinse with cold water.
# Transfer the chicken stock into a clean pot. Stir in the turmeric powder, black pepper, and curry powder. Cover, and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add the parboiled rice, making sure that the liquid is on the same level with the rice. Taste and add salt if necessary. Stir with a wooden spoon, and allow to cook on medium heat until the water is almost entirely dried up.
# Add the chopped onions and tomatoes. Cover and continue to cook until the water dries up.
# Stir to combine well, and serve.
